task.title: [Bug] With a pinned build ID, the controller keeps updating the Deployment after a template change
task.body:
### What are you really trying to do?

<!-- 
Tell us at a high level what you're doing, to avoid XY problem (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/XY_problem) 
-->

Change a pod template field on a WorkerDeployment that pins `unsafeCustomBuildID` and have it applied in place to the already-deployed version.

### Describe the bug

<!-- A clear and concise description of what the bug is. -->

<!-- If applicable, add screenshots or code blocks to help explain your problem. You can also use [Loom](http://loom.com/) to do short, free video bug reports. -->

The first update applies correctly, but then the controller detects drift on every reconcile and re-updates the same Deployment (~every 10s) until the spec changes. 

The `temporal.io/pod-template-spec-hash` annotation is produced by hashing different inputs during creation vs update.

 - [NewDeploymentWithOwnerRef](https://github.com/temporalio/temporal-workercontroller/blob/8ece9779577348a1436c58b9b3e8dc47af62114a/internal/k8s/deployments.go#L302-L318) applies controller's envvars/volumes after hashing the template.
 - [checkAndUpdateDeploymentPodTemplateSpec](https://github.com/temporalio/temporal-workercontroller/blob/8ece9779577348a1436c58b9b3e8dc47af62114a/internal/planner/planner.go#L600-L606) compares against the hash of the template.
 - [updateDeploymentWithPodTemplateSpec](https://github.com/temporalio/temporal-worker-controller/blob/8ece9779577348a1436c58b9b3e8dc47af62114a/internal/planner/planner.go#L648-L663) hashes _after_ applying the controller changes.

The impact is small. In my repro, the Deployment generation stayed constant across the updates without pod restarts, so the repeats are server-side no-ops. The cost is just an API write + a logline per reocncile per deployment.

### Minimal Reproduction

<!-- 
Modify our hello world templates to demonstrate:

- TypeScript: https://github.com/temporalio/samples-typescript/tree/main/hello-world
- Go: https://github.com/temporalio/money-transfer-project-template-go
- Java: https://github.com/temporalio/money-transfer-project-template-java
- PHP: https://github.com/temporalio/samples-php#samples
-->

1. Create a WorkerDeployment with `unsafeCustomBuildID: stable`
2. Change any pod template field
3. Watch the controller log: "updating deployment" indefinitely

Can also be seen via a unit test: run `checkAndUpdateDeploymentPodTemplateSpec` again after an update and it will return the Deployment again.

### Environment/Versions

<!-- Please complete the following information where relevant. -->

 - temporal-worker-controller main at 8ece977

### Additional context

<!-- Add any other context about the problem here. -->

I have a fix ready: hash the template before applying the controller. Happy to open a PR for this!
